title: Parts verification and delivery
task: Carry a sealed spare-parts case from dispatch to the load reader, hold it for registration, then reach the service dock past an occupied workbench.
planner: A two-leg mission with a measured registration interlock. A smooth departure segment aligns the case at the reader. After the full scan dwell, an 18-candidate curvature-continuous route search selects a wheel-driven path from check-in to the receiving dock.
criterion: Positive shortfall below the 460 mm study clearance between the robot collision envelope and the nearest lower-leg or shoe collider.
detail_target: Nearest Husky wheel and operator shoe at the same time.

audit.solver: MuJoCo wheel motors, four wheel/ground contact constraints and free-base dynamics. The human motion is prescribed independently.
audit.collision_measurement: Continuous solver checks target the manufacturer-sized base, wheels and bumper boxes/cylinders against four leg/shoe envelopes. Skin vertices were independently checked against those robot envelopes at 25 Hz. Foot planting applies to the displayed shoe mesh.

steps.text: Hold the sealed spare-parts case in its rack at dispatch.
Drive forward and align the side code with the fixed reader.
Hold alignment below 25 mm/s for a continuous 0.72 s scan.
Register the case and authorize the second leg.
Select a 0.45 m outward route to reserve clearance at the occupied bench.
Continue past the bench toward the receiving bay.
Brake in the marked receiving bay and hold the load for the receiver.
Confirm the entire base is parked and the registration is complete.

safe.summary: Register the load and use the outward route to the dock.
safe.caption: The Husky curves away from the stationary technician.

steps.text: Hold the sealed spare-parts case in its rack at dispatch.
Drive forward and align the side code with the fixed reader.
Hold alignment below 25 mm/s for a continuous 0.72 s scan.
Register the case and authorize the second leg.
Select the short aisle centerline past the occupied bench.
The route enters the 460 mm study clearance envelope while the technician remains at the bench.
Continue past the bench toward the receiving bay.
Brake in the marked receiving bay and hold the load for the receiver.
Confirm the entire base is parked and the registration is complete.

unsafe.summary: Register the same load and use the shorter centerline to the dock.
unsafe.caption: The direct route brings the wheel close to the technician’s shoes without physical contact.

revision.goal_criterion: Register the secured parts case at the side reader with at least 0.72 s of continuous alignment at less than 25 mm/s, then park the complete Husky footprint in the receiving bay with center error below 65 mm and terminal speed below 55 mm/s.
revision.scan_model: The side-facing code and reader sites must align in position and orientation while speed stays below threshold. The scan is modeled by pose and dwell.

revision_actions: Apply a C2-smooth asymmetric docking speed profile with zero endpoint velocities and an extended low-deceleration final approach.
Preserve normalized docking endpoints without altering human clearance intervals.
